definitions.model_output: One frozen per-residue joint Hchi estimate. There are no model-predicted chi1/2/3/4 angle entropies, widths, or free-energy curves.
definitions.primary_MD_metric: Per-angle 5-degree-bin Shannon entropy, natural logarithm, averaged over four origins 0,1.25,2.5,3.75 degrees.
definitions.secondary_MD_metric: Per-angle total length of all 5-degree boxes with Fstar=-ln(p/pmax)<=1, averaged over the same four origins; may be disconnected.
definitions.joint_reference: Original joint 120-degree-state Hchi, mean of five 1000-frame windows. A separate observation definition from the per-angle 501-frame fine-bin metrics.
definitions.MD_reference_association: A descriptive comparison using observed joint Hchi, not a predictor and not a ceiling for single-angle prediction accuracy.
definitions.angle_count_accuracy: Ordinary accuracy of the original joint Hchi output, stratified by the residue number of defined chi angles k. It is not the accuracy of predicting the kth angle.

handling.Pro_joint_reference: Original zero reference values retained; Pro angle observations remain valid and are included.
handling.undefined_angles: Not present in any per-chi correlation; retained as 113 missing slots in the 264-row source table. No zero imputation.
handling.AA_centering: Within each chi layer, subtract the arithmetic mean for the same amino-acid type separately from frozen joint Hchi and the MD single-angle metric, then compute Spearman over all defined positions in the layer.
handling.singletons: Retained in primary analysis. Both centered values are zero for a one-position amino-acid type. A separate repeated-AA-only sensitivity is provided; no selection by observed result.
handling.constant_type_groups: Retained as zero residuals/ties. A whole-layer correlation would be NaN if either centered variable were constant. Average ranks handle all ties.
handling.no_inference_intervals: No confidence intervals or p-values: one protein and small chi-layer samples, especially n=10 for chi4.
